**Repaired finding submitted (deviation, fallback level).**

What changed in response to the verifier:

1. **True-up element now in operative language.** I dropped the `already_met` claim on Subparagraph 7.7 (a one-off, RFS-Date-anchored Capital Costs settlement) and instead built the true-up into the inserted clause: on any reduction or shortfall we pay only our proportionate share of O&M Costs *actually incurred* for the period, trued up to actual cost, with "no penalty, forfeiture, reclamation of capacity or acceleration" in respect of the reduced amount — which also displaces the Paragraph 23 penalty-style consequence for the reduced amount without touching Paragraph 23 itself.
2. **Temporal anchor fixed.** The 12-month period is now anchored to "the RFS Date and each anniversary of it", a defined term in the agreement, rather than a floating "then-current" period.
3. **Numbering carried.** The insertion is labelled 7.2A, matching the comment.
4. **Level.** Still fallback only; preferred is expressly not claimed, since Schedule B proportionate cost-bearing survives and fees are not usage-based.
5. **Minimality preserved.** Single insertion after 7.2, no deletions, no survival tails or extra remedies, and favourable retained text (13.2/14.1 upgrade protections, 7.6/7.7 adjustments, 18.1 mechanics) left verbatim. All three fallback elements are now mapped to operation 1.
